name: Hairy Michaelmas-daisy
desc: Hairy Michaelmas-daisy (Symphyotrichum novae-angliae): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Symphyotrichum novae-angliae is a species of flowering plant in the aster family (Asteraceae) native to central and eastern North America.
